g.text: Concrete path: notify.v1 → Switchboard route.execute → approval decision → Messenger-owned adapter → normalized outcome
replay only through the native tool.
Retired surface: no delivery_requests, delivery_attempts, delivery_receipts, or delivery_dead_letter tables.
No tracking, queue, or health MCP/REST API. msg_003 locks first and drops only an empty legacy schema.
Observe live delivery via route outcomes, approval records, and the Switchboard attention ledger.
